summary: Configured node1 with a rootless Podman web application owned by appsvc. It serves HTTP on port 8080 and automatically recovered after reboot without an active appsvc login session.
actions_performed: Created the unprivileged appsvc account with subordinate UID/GID mappings and a non-login shell.
Created and started a Quadlet-managed nginx web application.
Rebooted node1 and verified automatic recovery.

evidence.requirement: Rootless containerized web application owned by appsvc
evidence.summary: The generated user service is active; Podman reports rootless=true; the container monitor is owned by appsvc UID 1000.
Port 8080 is listening and requests to node1 return HTTP 200 with the expected application content.

evidence.requirement: Starts at boot without an active appsvc login session
evidence.summary: Lingering is enabled; after reboot the service and container were active while appsvc had no login sessions.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 267e568a-ef2b-4189-9a7f-50a72b044473; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with changed boot ID 80df2799-9af1-4ce9-82d4-1d199b63830c; service, container, HTTP content, and no-session state recovered.
